854	counselors. One of the things: when someone comes to consult
855	you about problems in shalom bait, during the conversation,
856	of course, they always complain, say in the middle to the wife: what virtues
857	do you see in your husband? Then ask the husband: what
858	virtues does your wife have? What virtues do you see
859	in your wife? Because sometimes, from so much tension, they themselves don't notice
860	how much abundance of good there is at home. They focus only on the bad.
